experiment: Full-scale single-span, two-purlin-line diaphragm-braced strut-purlin roof assemblies (8 and 10 in. C and Z purlins with 26 ga through-fastened deck on one flange) were built upside down in a vacuum chamber and loaded to failure by simulated uplift alone, by concentric axial load alone, or by axial load applied while a preset uplift was held constant, with tensile coupons cut from the web of each failed purlin.
title: Strut-Purlin Research: Full-Scale Tests of Diaphragm-Braced Strut-Purlin Roof Assemblies

variables.definition: Test designation as printed, identifying the purlin depth/shape and the fastener spacing or percentage of uplift moment capacity held during the test.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (pp. 25-220) column test_id; Table 3.5 (p. 40) column test_designation
variables.name: Test designation
variables.note: Table 3.1 lists the same designations in its group notes rather than as a column.

variables.definition: Letter identifying the group of tests sharing the same purlin, deck and fastener components.
variables.name: Test group

variables.definition: Cold-formed purlin cross-section shape, C or Z.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 (p. 25) column purlin_shape; Table S1 column section_type
variables.name: Purlin section shape

variables.definition: Nominal depth of the cold-formed purlin section.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 (p. 25) column purlin_depth_in; Table S1 column depth_in
variables.name: Purlin depth

variables.definition: Nominal thickness of the purlin material for each test group.
variables.name: Nominal purlin thickness
variables.note: Distinct from the measured coupon thickness in Table 3.5.

variables.definition: Thickness measured on the tensile coupon cut from the web of the failed purlin, carried into the strength summary.
variables.evidence: Table 3.5 (p. 40) column thickness_in; Table S1 column thickness_in
variables.name: Measured purlin thickness

variables.definition: Gage of the through-fastened roof deck panel used in each test group.
variables.name: Deck gage
variables.note: All decking was 26 ga per header note.

variables.definition: Type of fastener used to attach the deck to the purlin flange (SDF = #12 self-drilling structural fasteners).
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 (p. 25) column fastener and its header note
variables.name: Fastener type

variables.definition: Spacing of the #12 self-drilling structural fasteners along the purlin flange.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 (p. 25) column fastener_spacing_in; Table S1 column fastener_spacing_in
variables.name: Deck-to-purlin fastener spacing

variables.definition: Spacing of the #14 self-drilling side-lap fasteners, stated as 2 ft 0 in. on center in the header notes of Tables 3.1 and S1.
variables.evidence: Header note of Table 3.1 (p. 25) and Table S1
variables.name: Side-lap fastener spacing
variables.note: Constant for all tests; not a column.

variables.definition: Measured yield stress of the purlin steel from the ASTM tensile coupon cut at midspan from the web of the failed purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 3.5 (p. 40) column yield_stress_ksi; Table S1 column yield_stress_ksi
variables.name: Yield stress

variables.definition: Measured ultimate tensile strength of the purlin steel from the tensile coupon.
variables.name: Tensile strength
variables.note: Header note flags SP-10C-12-2 where Fu equals Fy as printed.

variables.definition: Elongation at fracture measured on the standard tensile coupon.
variables.name: Coupon elongation

variables.definition: Direction/combination of applied loading for the test (vacuum-simulated uplift, concentric axial load, or both).
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Single span length of the test assembly.
variables.name: Span length

variables.definition: Number of spans in the test assembly (all single-span).
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the test assembly.
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Roof deck attachment type and gage used in the assembly (through-fastened 26 ga screw-down).
variables.name: Panel type

variables.definition: Description of bracing supplied to the purlins other than the deck (lateral supports at ends only).
variables.name: Bracing condition

variables.definition: Purlin lines were spaced at 5 ft centers with a 1 ft deck overhang and 7 ft wide deck, stated in the Table S1 header note.
variables.name: Purlin spacing and deck width
variables.note: Constant for all assemblies; not a column.

variables.definition: Load at failure exactly as printed in the report: an axial load (kips) for the combined-load tests and a uniform uplift load (plf) for the uplift-only tests.
variables.name: Failure load as printed

variables.definition: Unit in which the printed failure load is reported (kips or plf).
variables.name: Failure load unit
variables.note: Metadata column accompanying the failure load.

variables.definition: Applied midspan bending moment at failure exactly as printed.
variables.name: Failure moment

variables.definition: Unit in which the printed failure moment is reported (in-kip).
variables.name: Failure moment unit
variables.note: Metadata column accompanying the failure moment.

variables.definition: Narrative description of the observed failure mechanism of the assembly.
variables.name: Failure mode

variables.definition: Uniformly distributed uplift load held on the assembly at failure, including roof-system dead weight, as printed.
variables.name: Applied uplift at failure
variables.note: For the uplift-only tests this equals the printed failure load.

variables.definition: Roof-system dead weight included in the reported uplift loads: about 5 plf for 8 in. Z, 7.6 plf for 10 in. Z and 9 plf for 10 in. C assemblies, stated in the Table S1 notes.
variables.name: Roof system dead weight
variables.note: Not a column; given per assembly type in the notes.

variables.definition: Theoretical axial failure load of the strut-purlin computed in the report, as printed.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column predicted_axial_load_kips (also Table 3.2, p. 29, per header note)
variables.name: Predicted axial failure load
variables.note: Printed as 'TBD' for the 8 in. Z tests; minor discrepancies noted between Table 3.2 and the data packs.

variables.definition: Printed ratio of the actual to the predicted axial failure load.
variables.name: Actual/predicted axial load

variables.definition: Printed ratio of the axial load at failure to the calculated axial capacity Pa.
variables.name: P/Pa ratio
variables.note: Header note flags inconsistencies for SP-10Z-0 and SP-10C-0.

variables.definition: Printed ratio of the applied midspan moment at failure to the calculated uplift moment capacity Max.
variables.name: M/Max ratio

variables.definition: Predicted uplift capacity of 117.1 plf (M = 109.7 in-kip) for SP-10C-M, stated in a Table S1 header note for comparison with the measured 151.3 plf.
variables.evidence: Header note of Table S1 concerning SP-10C-M
variables.name: Predicted uplift capacity
variables.note: Given only for SP-10C-M in a note, not as a column.
